description: Count a period stated in days from a date under FRCP 6(a) or FRAP 26(a): leave out the trigger day, count every day, and if the last day is a weekend or legal holiday roll to the next open day (or, for a period counted backward before an event, to the preceding one). Optionally adds 3 days under FRCP 6(d) or FRAP 26(c) after the roll, for a period that runs after being served. Returns the due date under the prevailing reading, and the earliest and latest dates when observed or closure days make the readings differ. Use this for a period no specific rule row covers, such as one set by a court order. With court_open_days, counts only days a district court is open instead, for a local rule that states its period that way.

court_open_days.description: Optional, FRCP only, and only with a district whose local rules this site applies (federal_local_deadline accepts it): true counts only days that court is open, skipping weekends, legal holidays and the days its posted schedule closes the court. The last day counted is a day the court is open, so it is not rolled. Not with service_method.

date.description: The date of the event the period counts from. That day itself is not counted.

days.description: How many days: calendar days, or with court_open_days only days the court is open. Negative counts backward, for a period measured before an event. Not zero.

district.description: Optional. The CM/ECF id of the district court, such as casd, cacd, nysd or dcd. Adds the notes for that district and the Ninth Circuit notes for California districts. Required with court_open_days.

frap_delivery.description: FRAP only, and only when the period runs after being served: how the paper was delivered. "other" adds 3 days under FRAP 26(c). served-electronically = Served electronically: adds nothing; delivered-on-proof-date = Delivered on the date stated in the proof of service: adds nothing; other = Any other service: adds 3 days (FRAP 26(c)).

regime.description: frcp (default) counts under FRCP 6(a), for the district court; frap counts under FRAP 26(a), for an appeal.

service_method.description: FRCP only, and only when the period runs after being served: how the paper was served under Rule 5(b)(2). Mail, leaving it with the clerk and other consented means add 3 days under Rule 6(d); the rest add nothing. 5b2C-mail = Mail (Rule 5(b)(2)(C)); 5b2D-clerk = Leaving it with the clerk (Rule 5(b)(2)(D)); 5b2F-consented-other = Other means you consented to in writing (Rule 5(b)(2)(F)); 5b2E-electronic = The court's electronic-filing system or other consented electronic means (Rule 5(b)(2)(E)): adds nothing; 5b2A-handing = Handing it to the person (Rule 5(b)(2)(A)): adds nothing; 5b2B-leaving = Leaving it at the office or home (Rule 5(b)(2)(B)): adds nothing.

name: federal_count_days
title: Count a federal period in days
